Go]] |blank1_name = Political party |blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|Partido Federal ng Pilipinas}}|border=darkgray}} [[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas|PFP]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Isabela's 2nd congressional district''' is one of the six [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Isabela (province)|Isabela]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 13, 2021 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} The district consists of the east-central municipalities of [[Benito Soliven, Isabela|Benito Soliven]], [[Gamu]], [[Naguilian, Isabela|Naguilian]], [[Palanan]], [[Reina Mercedes, Isabela|Reina Mercedes]] and [[San Mariano, Isabela|San Mariano]]. It also consisted of the western municipalities of [[Aurora, Isabela|Aurora]], [[Burgos, Isabela|Burgos]], [[Mallig]], [[Quezon, Isabela|Quezon]], [[Quirino, Isabela|Quirino]], [[Roxas, Isabela|Roxas]], and [[San Manuel, Isabela|San Manuel]] until the 2019 redistricting that incorporated Palanan and Reina Mercedes into the district.{{cite web|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/2018/09/27/republic-act-no-11080/ |title=Republic Act No. 11080 |date=27 September 2018 |publisher=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)]] |accessdate=February 13, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Ed Christopher Go|Ed Christopher S. Go]] of the [[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas]] (PFP).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 13, 2021}}{{cite press release|url=https://www.congress.gov.ph/media/press-releases/view/?content=9016&title=Lakas-CMD+membership+reaches+103%2C+one-third+of+total+House+members|title=Lakas-CMD membership reaches 103, one-third of total House members|accessdate=August 7, 2024|date=August 7, 2024|website=House of Representatives}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
